hurdle_rate_pa: ASSUMED: 5%/yr opportunity cost of stablecoin capital

HL: ASSUMED 10x effective; HL allows more, we would not use it

transfer_delay_min: ASSUMED: 20 min single-leg exposure per rebalance
rebalances_per_trade: ASSUMED: one rebalance every 20 round trips
vol_ann: ASSUMED: 60% annualised vol of the underlying for the risk charge
risk_price: ASSUMED: charge one sigma of the naked-leg move as cost
leg_fail_rate: MEASURED 2026-09-04: scanner quotes 2975/3164 per cycle -> ~6% of legs unquotable at any moment (proxy for API failure)
fail_loss_bps: ASSUMED: a failed second leg costs ~half the band + a crossing
outage_hours_pa: MEASURED: one 46-min full outage in 5 days -> annualised hours; charged only if it hits a hold
